spec.claim: On the SO-101 lift task, a policy pressed WITH per-episode visual randomization (headlight 0.5-1.5, front camera ±1 cm) vs WITHOUT, same 64 episodes, same dynamics DR, same trainer, judged on 80 matched trials under the SAME visual sweep at a pinned truth.

fixed.basis: declared span ±0.30 around nominal (the folklore DR, docs/31)

visual.basis: declared span ±0.30 around nominal (the folklore DR, docs/31)
visual.visual_basis: declared visual span: headlight 0.5-1.5, front camera ±1 cm (the maintainers' data-engine note (private) §4; the so101 scenes are lit by the headlight only, the maintainers' progress log (private) 2026-09-02)

caveats: The evaluation sweep equals the training sweep by design: this measures robustness inside the declared visual span, not generalization beyond it.
The scene's only light is MuJoCo's headlight; scene-light randomization is not exercised.
One camera (front, 576x1024): the three-camera rig trained 10x slower on the pod (1.4 step/s, 2026-09-04) and C1's earlier nulls were single-camera; comparability over coverage.
